coverage.non_warrant_content: P001 establishes the working objects and documentary scope: sampled orders and traces connecting approval, placement and system records. Its imperative framing adds no separate conclusion about any order. The other state spans supply the reconstruction proposal, factual sample result, evidentiary distinction, applicability check and provisional assumptions captured above.

The week-one and week-two labels in P006 and P011 schedule the work. P009's collection list supplies routine data-entry instructions for identifiers, amounts, approval content, authority and dates; it does not establish values for those data. The substantive distinction among date types is captured separately. No individual noun in the collection list is treated as an independent proposition.

The observation and logging imperatives organize collection rather than report results. P018 qualifies the proposed observations and is included substantively in their cited bundles; it is not treated as proof that any proposed configuration occurs. P019's logging mechanics add no separate finding beyond the bounded interpretation of unsuccessful searches.

P024's week-three board-review timing and instruction to prepare a table specify scheduling and presentation. The table's substantive evidentiary distinctions and the connection between recommendations and supported failures are captured. No order-level classifications or specific remedies are supplied by this field.

The remaining imperative form organizes stopping, reporting, follow-up and record handling. The substantive conditions and constraints are captured, including both stopping branches. No specific owner, next request, record correction or unresolved case is identified.
